meta.title: HelloSquad: your AI squad takes over the marketing
meta.description: HelloSquad is an AI marketing team for small and medium-sized businesses: seven specialists who share your brand’s memory and work together. You make the decisions.

definition: HelloSquad works like an AI marketing team for small and medium-sized businesses. Seven specialists share the same brand memory and work in coordination. You ask, the squad organizes and executes. The decisions stay yours: approve, authorize, confirm.

responsibilities.nexo: Coordination: routes requests and tracks projects and work.
responsibilities.kiwi: Paid media, SEO and organic acquisition, conversion, and testing.

landing.squadLead: Seven specialist agents who know your brand and work together, from strategy to execution.
landing.flowLead: See how one simple conversation brings in the right specialists, organizes the work and puts the decisions in your hands.
landing.flowStep1: You say what you need, in your own words.
landing.flowStep2: Nexo turns the request into a piece of work and calls in the right specialists.
landing.flowStep3: The specialists produce using what your brand has already decided.
landing.flowStep4: You review, ask for changes or approve. Publishing, sending and spending each need a separate authorization.
landing.autoText: In Autonomous Mode, you hand off a recurring responsibility, like preparing the week’s posts or tracking results every day. The squad agrees with you on scope, frequency and limits, and every cycle is logged. You can pause or revoke it at any time, and nothing goes out without the authorization you gave.
landing.memoryTitleLine1: A squad that knows your brand.
landing.memoryLead: Your brand, your goals and your decisions become shared knowledge. So every specialist works with more context, every time.
landing.memoryText: Brand Memory keeps what your business has already decided: audience, tone of voice, channels, products, words you never use and corrections you made. Every specialist checks the same memory, so you never repeat the brief. What the squad notices on its own comes in as a suggestion and only becomes a rule when you confirm it.
landing.resultsTitleLine2: Your squad turns them into action.
landing.resultsText: Íris reads the numbers from the channels you connected, always with source, period and unit, and explains what changed in plain language. When the cause isn’t clear, she says so. Her recommendation becomes work for the right specialist, and any budget change only happens with your authorization.

ld.orgDescription: HelloSquad is an AI marketing team for small and medium-sized businesses: seven specialists who share the brand’s memory, work in coordination and leave the decisions to the business owner.
ld.appDescription: AI marketing team for small and medium-sized businesses. Seven specialists (coordination, strategy, brand and creative, content, growth marketing, CRM and results) take requests in a conversation, organize the work and deliver reviewable material. Publishing, sending and spending require the account owner’s authorization.
